newsitem.title: USA: Emerson Electric encouraged by strong Q1.
newsitem.headline: Emerson Electric encouraged by strong Q1.

text.p: Emerson Electric Co said Tuesday it achieved record results for its fiscal first quarter ended December 31, and chairman Charles Knight called the performance encouraging.
"Our profitability plan for the remainder of the fiscal year should help us maintain this momentum," Knight said in a statement.

Knight said the company is concerned about the impact a strengthening dollar may have on its international results, but Emerson expects European economies to improve in the second half. He said he was "cautiously optimistic" about the outlook for the rest of the year.
Emerson, a manufacturer of electronic products, posted first-quarter earnings of $1.14 a share on sales of $2.83 billion.

"All of our businesses reported higher sales this quarter, reflecting solid international and moderate domestic demand, and the contribution of 1996 acquisitions," Knight noted. "Excluding the negative impact of currency, underlying international sales showed good improvement due to very strong export sales and continued strength in the Asia-Pacific and Latin American regions."
